sophia: Quick postmortem follow-up: we listed several GPU capacity/autoscale action items. Need a single-line owner + ETA and a 1-line rollback for SRE. I'll push into the tracker at EOD.

mike: I'll take scheduler tuning. Short ETA: propose parameters and canary plan. Will include fairness weight experiments and preemption thresholds. ETA: 8 business days. Rollback: revert weights to last stable commit and disable feature flag.

raj: I'll handle vendor quota requests and a sales-assisted emergency uplift path. Filing support ticket now. ETA: initial request 2 business days. Rollback: enable reserved burst capacity + route affected tenants to alternate region if vendor delay.

_tess: I'll add a lightweight staging canary (10% traffic), perf baseline, and a p99 profiled alert. ETA: 3 days. Rollback: mute canary split and revert routing to baseline; run quick smoke tests.

nate: I'll draft an emergency headroom playbook and propose an ad-hoc surge oncall rota. Will include exact console steps to flip autoscale/burst flags. ETA: 5 days. Rollback: document console path to reduce max_instances and enable throttles for low-priority lanes.

ops-bot: Ticket opened: INF-4010 \u2014 "Surge capacity vendor request" (assignee: raj) https://tracker.redwood.ai/INF-4010

sophia: Short plan notes:
- Scheduler (mike): A/B fair_share +/-20%, preempt_threshold tweaks, feature flagged rollout, canary 10% 48h.
- Quota (raj): vendor form + sales fallback; reserve burst if delayed.
- Canary & alert (tess): p99 alert -> page after 10m; dashboard tile for canary.
- Runbook & rota (nate): explicit escalation contacts and quick steps.

mike: Canary details: start with internal traffic, compare p50/p95/p99 and error rate. If p99 improves with lower preemption -> widen to 25% then full. If errors spike -> rollback to prior scheduler config.

raj: Filing vendor request now and looping Sales/Security for enterprise accounts. ETA to file: end of day tomorrow.

_tess: PromQL for p99 alert (will refine):
```
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, tenant))
```
Alert: p99 > 500ms for 10m -> page oncall.

nate: Runbook stub (short): 1) route noncritical tenants to quantized variant; 2) increase autoscale max_instances if quota; 3) trigger pre-warmed pool; 4) enable reserved capacity via Sales.

sophia: Please paste your 1-line rollback into this thread when done. I'll update the remediation tracker and schedule a 30-min follow-up sync next Tue. Calendar incoming. :calendar:

mike: rollback posted above.

raj: rollback posted.

_tess: rollback posted.

nate: rollback posted and PR link will follow.

ops-bot: Meeting created: "Surge playbook owners sync" Tue 14:00  attendees: sophia, mike, raj, tess, nate

sophia: Thanks team  keep incremental updates here so the postmortem actions reflect live state. :eyes:
